title: Pinia: stores, state, getters and actions

videos.script:
Two lessons ago, a composable gave every caller its own copy of the data. Last lesson, the router's guard had to fetch the courses a second time, because a guard is not a component. {{why}} Both problems have one answer. A store. State that lives outside every component, with one copy for the whole application.

You will install Pinia, and watch a composable count twice while a store counts once. {{setup}} Then the planner's store, written the setup way, which is the Composition API you already know.

{{options}} Then the options way, which most examples on the web use, and the reset it gives for free. {{refs}} Then lesson two's first trap, in a new place. A value destructured from a store that never moves again.

{{subscribe}} Then subscribe, which watches a whole store and says what kind of change it saw.

{{planner}} And last, the planner moves into its store. A session ticked on a course page appears on the week's page, and the data file is fetched once, for everybody.
